title: Establishment.
bodyText:
PART III. STATE HIGHWAY SYSTEM

There is established a state highway system which shall consist of federal-aid highways and other public highways which may be designated for inclusion in the system pursuant to section 264-42.
caseNotes: A public highway is not a state highway unless it is designated for inclusion in the state highway system. 2 H. App. 387, 633 P.2d 1118 (1981).

bodyHtml:
PART III.  STATE HIGHWAY SYSTEM

 

     §264-41  Establishment.  There is established a state highway system which shall consist of federal-aid highways and other public highways which may be designated for inclusion in the system pursuant to section 264-42. [L 1965, c 159, pt of §1; Supp, §111-51; HRS §264-41]

 

Case Notes

 

  A public highway is not a state highway unless it is designated for inclusion in the state highway system.  2 H. App. 387, 633 P.2d 1118 (1981).
